episode_id: Update this branch from upstream and make sure the dependency list still makes sense. Keep my dependency file, with what I removed still removed, and add what upstream added./seed-2-lockfile_conflict-4812

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (lockfile_conflict seed 5 resolves to 'take_upstream', which accepts ['take_upstream'], but the program implements 'keep_local'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.intent: Merge the upstream branch into the current branch and resolve a deps.lock conflict by keeping locally removed dependency lines removed, preserving local additions, and adding upstream's new dependency lines while taking non-package lines such as the version from upstream.

postconditions.description: no merge is left in progress
postconditions.name: merge_completed

postconditions.description: deps.lock contains no merge conflict markers
postconditions.name: deps_lock_no_conflict_markers

postconditions.description: package lines removed on the local side are absent from the final deps.lock
postconditions.name: local_removals_still_removed
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2) || exit 1
removed=$(comm -23 \
  <(git show "$base:deps.lock" | grep '^[[:space:]]*"' | sort) \
  <(git show "HEAD^1:deps.lock" | grep '^[[:space:]]*"' | sort)) || exit 1
if [ -n "$removed" ]; then
  test -z "$(comm -12 \
    <(printf '%s\n' "$removed" | sort) \
    <(git show HEAD:deps.lock | grep '^[[:space:]]*"' | sort))"
else
  true
fi

postconditions.description: package lines added on the local side are present in the final deps.lock
postconditions.name: local_additions_preserved
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2) || exit 1
added=$(comm -13 \
  <(git show "$base:deps.lock" | grep '^[[:space:]]*"' | sort) \
  <(git show "HEAD^1:deps.lock" | grep '^[[:space:]]*"' | sort)) || exit 1
if [ -n "$added" ]; then
  test -z "$(comm -23 \
    <(printf '%s\n' "$added" | sort) \
    <(git show HEAD:deps.lock | grep '^[[:space:]]*"' | sort))"
else
  true
fi

postconditions.description: package lines added upstream are present in the final deps.lock
postconditions.name: upstream_additions_present
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2) || exit 1
added=$(comm -13 \
  <(git show "$base:deps.lock" | grep '^[[:space:]]*"' | sort) \
  <(git show "HEAD^2:deps.lock" | grep '^[[:space:]]*"' | sort)) || exit 1
if [ -n "$added" ]; then
  test -z "$(comm -23 \
    <(printf '%s\n' "$added" | sort) \
    <(git show HEAD:deps.lock | grep '^[[:space:]]*"' | sort))"
else
  true
fi

postconditions.description: the working tree is clean after the merge commit
postconditions.name: worktree_clean_after_merge

preconditions.description: the upstream remote-tracking branch exists as a commit
preconditions.name: upstream_tracking_ref_exists

preconditions.description: HEAD and upstream each contain commits the other lacks
preconditions.name: branch_diverged_from_upstream

preconditions.description: deps.lock exists in the merge base and differs from it on both HEAD and upstream
preconditions.name: deps_lock_changed_on_both_sides
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) &&
git cat-file -e "$base:deps.lock" &&
git cat-file -e HEAD:deps.lock &&
git cat-file -e {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:deps.lock &&
! git diff --quiet "$base" HEAD -- deps.lock &&
! git diff --quiet "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} -- deps.lock

preconditions.description: deps.lock is the only path changed on both HEAD and upstream since the merge base
preconditions.name: deps_lock_is_only_overlapping_change
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) &&
test -z "$(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  | grep -vx 'deps.lock')"

preconditions.description: no merge is in progress, or MERGE_HEAD is the upstream branch
preconditions.name: merge_state_matches_upstream
preconditions.probe:
if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  test "$(git rev-parse MERGE_HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})"
else
  true
fi

preconditions.description: the worktree is clean, or an in-progress merge has only deps.lock conflicted
preconditions.name: worktree_ready_for_merge
preconditions.probe:
if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  test -z "$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U | grep -vx 'deps.lock')"
else
  test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
fi
